Effective Date: 10 July 2025

This Cookie Policy explains how Merso B.V. (“we”, “our”, “us”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. By continuing to browse or use our website, you agree to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work, improve user experience, and provide information to the site owner. Cookies can be “session cookies” that are deleted when you close your browser or “persistent cookies” that remain on your device until they expire or are deleted.

We use different types of cookies for various purposes. Strictly necessary cookies enable basic website functionality such as page navigation, secure login, and order processing. Performance cookies collect information about how visitors use our site, such as which pages are visited most often, so we can improve our website. Functional cookies remember your preferences, such as your selected language or region. Targeting and advertising cookies are used to deliver relevant marketing messages and measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns.

Some cookies are placed by us directly, while others are set by third-party services that appear on our pages, such as analytics providers, payment processors, or advertising partners. Third-party cookies are subject to the respective privacy and cookie policies of those providers.

You can control or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or set alerts when cookies are being sent. If you choose to disable cookies, some features of our website may not function properly and your shopping experience may be affected.

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. The latest version will always be posted on our website with the updated effective date.

If you have any questions about our use of cookies, you can contact us at Merso B.V., support@merso.com.

Why Merino 

100% Ultra-Fine Merino

Nature’s finest performance fiber. Upgraded.

Merino wool is breathable, thermoregulating, odor-resistant, and incredibly soft, nature’s own high-performance material.

Unlike synthetics, it stays fresh and adapts to your body. Unlike cotton, it insulates even when wet and dries fast. Unlike traditional wool, it’s itch-free, lightweight, and wearable all year.

At Merso®️, we take pure merino and give it an edge:

  • Machine-washable: thanks to advanced treatments.
  • Structured fit:  engineered through precision knitting.
  • Lasting comfort:  spun to resist pilling and retain shape.
  • Unlimited colors:  curated tones with rich, wearable depth.

100% merino. Pure performance. For Everyday Adventures

settings.title: How to wash
settings.content:
• Machine wash temperature (30°C / 85°F)
  • Use a gentle cycle
  • Mild detergent only
  • Turn garments inside out
  • Wash with like colors

settings.title: How to Dry
settings.content:
• Lay flat to dry
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not wring or twist
  • Never hang wet, it can stretch the fibers

settings.title: How to Store
settings.content:
• Fold, don’t hang, to preserve the shape
  • Keep in a dry, cool place
  • Optional: use cedar or lavender to naturally deter moths

settings.title: Pro Tip
settings.subheading: Care less. Wear more. That’s the Merso way.
settings.content: Merino stays fresh for longer. Air it out between wears to reduce washing and extend its life.
